== Composed official source and chronology ==
Four documented image layouts are listed in supported source order. Repository dates identify preserved full-face copies; the archive capture and printed edition identify partial-sheet occurrences. Exact first publication days of the partials remain unknown.
* '''Original full face''' ([[Mandalorian Mishap (V)]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable repository import, 8 July 2018]. No errata mark.
* '''Errata 1, earlier partial''' ([[Mandalorian Mishap (V) (Errata)]]): present in the complete official PDF archived at 2021-10-05T19:21:57Z. No errata mark.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-8-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-6-extract.pdf|Official Set 8 PDF archived 5 October 2021, lossless page extract]], original page 6 (extract page 2).</ref>
* '''Errata 2, current full face''' ([[Mandalorian Mishap (V) (Errata 2)]]): rerender published in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69], committed 2022-07-10T19:39:59Z. No errata mark. The full-face state retains the supported <code>208_20</code> mapping.
* '''Errata 3, later partial''' ([[Mandalorian Mishap (V) (Errata 3)]]): June 2023 sheet edition. No errata mark. The set 8 badge is larger, and text/title placement differs from the earlier partial; these are real layout changes rather than JPEG encoding noise.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf|Official Set 8 PDF, June 2023 edition]], page 6.</ref>
All four show the same game-text words. The absent marks on the three later image ordinals are recorded in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:V8-L-mandalorianmishap-Set8-2021-2023-partial-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and later published partial layouts.]]

The earlier PDF uses vector text/icons over reused background objects. The complete composed rectangle is the source image; background-only JPEG extraction is insufficient. No executable ID is assigned to either partial. Existing supported mapping remains on the moved current full-face article. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
